The placeholder rounds do not count toward drop activation but do sit in the drop candidate pool as zero candidates.

Drops crossed — first live-drop witness, with a twist: DropScoreOption=0 (drop lowest task cells) with Drop1AtRound=5 and Drop2AtRound=9 (Drop3..5=14/19/24; F3QDrop6to10='99,...'). Option-0 activation counts DISTINCT rounds with RawScore>0 (arithmetic story, Drop-worst §3), so only rounds 1-5 count: Drop1 activates exactly at its threshold of 5 scored rounds, and Drop2@9 NEVER ACTIVATES — not even on a zero cell, because the denominator never reaches 9. The single dropped cell is nevertheless a zero for every pilot: candidates sort value ASC then RoundNo DESC (latest equally-bad first), so R9 (zero placeholder) drops ahead of every real score; each pilot keeps all five real normalised scores and their full five-round sum minus penalties. Transcript reconciled: exactly one '*' per pilot, on Rnd9.

The three non-zero Landing values (145.0, round 4, pilots 13/28/56) are NOT landing-scheme lookups: the F3K family row has no landing-reference field at all (verified against the F3K table schema — following the data finds nothing to resolve), and CalcRawScoreF3K treats the landing-distance slot as ladder-task input (task D 'Ladder (Not FAI)'). lookups.landingSchemes is therefore empty, and validate.py rule 2 (which requires a Dur family row with durLndg) cannot evaluate this fixture — see story WI-5.

Penalty observations: four rows carry Penalty=100 (pilot 42 in R1; pilot 56 in R2 and R3; pilot 65 in R3). NormalisedScore cells are pre-penalty; GS subtracts each pilot's penalty total from the summed kept cells afterwards — transcript Penalty column shows ZZPotter 100, ZZNancarrow 200, ZZIrvin 100 (e.g. ZZNancarrow cells sum 3602, Score shown 3402).

Round-2 encoding oddity: task A(1) stores its result in the Laps column with all four Time columns zero — ten rows with non-zero NormalisedScore and no flight-time data. This exactly explains the gap between 'rows with any time' (39) and 'rows with NS != 0' (49).

GroupScoreDecimals=0 gives integral scores, so as with the other three fixtures the float32 persist casts are unwitnessed: every persisted RawScore/NormalisedScore reprs clean at its decimal count and survives a binary32 round-trip unchanged across all 90 rows.
